_source: The confirmation's note (and its question, where it is not "Are you sure you want to destroy this item?") for each item's Destroy, by obj gameval, as live sends them in confirmdestroy_init (rsprox captures). Quest items are not listed yet. An item not listed gets DestroyItem's own default note.

items.aide_arrow: You can get more Training arrows by talking to the Ranged Combat skill tutor north of Lumbridge Castle.
items.aide_shortbow: You can get another Training bow by talking to the Ranged Combat skill tutor north of Lumbridge Castle.
items.book_of_the_dead: You can obtain another from Commander Fullore at Kourend Castle.
items.brut_fishing_rod: You can search Otto's bed for another.
items.brut_logbook: I can obtain another from Otto.
items.bunnyears: You can get a replacement from Diango or Thessalia.
items.champion_lamp: Search the chest in the Champions' Challenge gallery for a replacement.
items.chronicle: You can buy another from Diango.
items.contact_keris: You can obtain another from Selim in Al Kharid.

fossil_glistening_tear.question: Destroy the entire stack?
fossil_glistening_tear.note: You will have to gather more tears underwater around Fossil Island.
